blocks.text:
This programme brings together different sides of Peru in one journey. Lima reveals colonial architecture and the Pacific coast. Cusco and Machu Picchu introduce you to the Inca heritage. On Lake Titicaca, you will see the floating Uros Islands. In Colca, the route reaches a high-altitude canyon and its condors before descending to Arequipa, the White City. Iquitos takes you from the Andes to humid rainforest, boats and the Amazon.

## Main sections of the route

In Lima, you will see Miraflores, Love Park, the historic centre, the Cathedral, Santo Domingo Monastery and Casa Aliaga. An evening visit to the fountain complex is included.

In Cusco, the programme includes Sacsayhuamán, Qorikancha, Tambomachay and Puka Pukara. From here, you will also visit Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley, with Pisac, Ollantaytambo, Chinchero, Moray and the Awanakancha centre.

On the way to Puno, you can choose the regular bus route with stops or the Titicaca Train. On Lake Titicaca, you will visit the Uros reed islands before continuing to the Colca Canyon and Arequipa.

After returning to Lima, you can add a Paracas – Nazca day trip. You then fly to Iquitos and board a boat along the Amazon to Heliconia Lodge.

## Programme price

Prices are per person in US dollars, with an English-speaking guide.

For the 3* category, an extra night in Lima costs $105 for SGL or DBL and $216 for TPL. For the 4* category, an extra night costs $187 for SGL or DBL and $281 for TPL. For the 5* category, an extra night in a DBL room costs $317.

4* hotels: Ikonik in Lima, Xima in Cusco, Casona Plaza in Puno, Refugio in Colca and Posada del Monasterio HSA in Arequipa, or hotels of the same category.

5* hotels: Iberostar in Lima, Arangua in Cusco, GHL in Puno, Colca Lodge in Colca, Sonesta Posada del Inca in Arequipa and Ceiba Tops in Iquitos, or hotels of the same category.
